description: Create or update up to 50 test cases (title, preconditions, steps, expected result) on a task you can access, after the user approved them. Each case has your referenceID: a case with the same referenceID on the task is updated instead of added, so repeating the call is harmless. The cases show in the task's Test cases area.

cases.description: 1-50 cases; each referenceID once. Cases with a referenceID already on the task are updated, the others are added.

referenceID.description: Your stable key for the case (e.g. "TC-1" or the PRD scenario number). Saving the same referenceID again updates that case instead of adding another.

sortOrder.description: Order in the task's list. Default: after the existing cases (unchanged on update).

steps.description: Steps in order (stored one per line).

name: laviya_create_test_cases
title: Create Test Cases
